Support workflow

How issues are handled once a request reaches the team.

1. Triage

Requests are classified as coupon issue, payment issue, payout issue, verification issue, or account issue.

2. Record review

Support checks linked coupon, order, seller, buyer, and payment records before taking action.

3. Escalation

Sensitive cases can move to dispute or admin review with a full audit trail.

4. Resolution

Users receive the final action, next steps, and any required follow-up details.

Best for payment issues

Include Razorpay payment reference, order ID, and the exact time of payment.

Best for coupon issues

Include the coupon title, expected benefit, redeem attempt result, and screenshot proof.

Best for seller issues

Include listing ID, verification stage, and withdrawal request details if payout is delayed.
